title: WP-UAT-C: deterministic G10 controls, lean disabled — enforce the precondition B's judgement rested on, and make UAT-I17 mechanical
objective: Add the deterministic G10/UAT controls the A-rung ladder committed WP-UAT-C to, and close BADF-QA's #266. At rung B, U4 refuses a critical failure only under RECOMMEND_ACCEPT; I defended that boundary on the grounds that conditions are exactly where a known critical failure gets named. QA agreed the RATIONALE and demonstrated it was ENFORCED BY NOTHING -- conditions, known_defects_acknowledged and declared_non_coverage_acknowledged are all optional in schemas/uat.schema.json, so a disposition whose NAME asserts conditions exist required none, and UAT-I13's aggregate-burying was reachable one enum value over. This rung enforces the precondition rather than withdrawing the judgement, which is the right repair when a rationale is sound and unguarded. It also converts UAT-I17 from a promise into a mechanism.
business_value: Two of these controls close a hole that a reviewer reached one enum value away from a control that looked complete -- the kind of gap that survives review precisely because the adjacent case reads as covered. C10 is the larger structural gain: UAT-I17 says a material candidate change invalidates an acceptance, and until this rung that was prose in a reference. Recomputing the scenario-set digest means an acceptance cannot be carried forward silently across a changed scenario set, which is the difference between a documented invariant and an enforced one.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: C7 (unnamed critical under RECOMMEND_ACCEPT_WITH_CONDITIONS refused, UAT-I13), C8 (ACCEPTED_WITH_CONDITIONS with no conditions refused), C9 (unconditional ACCEPTED over an unacknowledged not-passing critical refused), C10 (acceptance.scenario_set_digest recomputed over the carried scenarios, UAT-I17), C11 (not_covered with neither a reason nor a declared non_coverage entry refused, UAT-I12)
tests/test_badf_uat_evidence.py: UatDeterministicControlTests -- one test per control plus an additivity assertion; five B-rung fixtures given a scenario_set_digest C10 can recompute
badf/demands/BADF-DEM-0111.json; docs/governance/GITHUB_CONTROL_PLANE.md doctrine section; work/WP-2026-0125/ record and G07 self-dossier; lockfile re-sign
out_of_scope: cross-evidence and cross-dossier checks -- single-object controls only, per #266's own exclusion
binding an acknowledgement to a defect RESOLUTION state (#266 excludes this explicitly)
any adapter or subskill registration; scenario-derivation logic; any lifecycle.json change; any second gate (UAT-I20)
badf-production-readiness's release-packet and operational-readiness types; WP-UAT-D (shadow) and WP-UAT-E (admission)
acceptance_criteria: C7-C11 each refuse their violation naming the governing invariant, and admit the corrected form

Every control mutation-checked INDIVIDUALLY with survivors reported as a deliverable (#266 criterion 4): 0 survivors, 0 sites without an in-process liveness witness, under the full protocol -- -B, __pycache__ cleared between mutations, NAMED negative control first, git checkout -- restore, and parser anti-vacuity asserting the parsed test count equals the module-declared count
Untyped uat bindings remain admissible -- additive, as WP-UAT-B established

Open-ended per #270: the adjacent encodings are enumerated and walked -- every other disposition value, every other acknowledgement field, an empty-string condition, and a condition naming a different scenario -- and none admits an unnamed critical failure
No lifecycle change, no second gate, no adapter registered

test_obligations.claim: a critical failure carried under WITH_CONDITIONS or an unconditional ACCEPTED must be named in conditions or acknowledged defects
an acceptance cannot be carried forward across a changed scenario set
each of the five controls is individually mutation-killed with a liveness witness

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR; the rung is additive for untyped bindings, so reverting restores the pre-C admissibility exactly

note: Rung C of the badf-uat A-E ladder; B landed as #264 (d0986b0). PROVENANCE PER CONTROL, stated because C is deliberately wider than #266: C7/C8/C9 are #266 criteria 2/1/3 and fully close it; C10 and C11 come from the ladder's own C-rung text (staleness detection; non-derivable-criterion declared, never dropped) plus BADF-QA's routed coverage-exactness note. A reviewer should not read C10/C11 as scope creep. expected_surfaces DECLARED UP FRONT -- the #264 lesson, where its absence cost a REV condition; the gate-forced reconcile sits in discovery_allowance because a reconcile collapses to a no-op for whoever lands second, though note GOV-0119/#272: the assembly-side containment does not consult discovery_allowance, so if that raises C-2 the reconcile moves to files with a prune-on-collapse obligation. FIXTURE NOTE: five B-rung fixtures needed a scenario_set_digest C10 can recompute. Those tests do not assert C10's ABSENCE -- their DATA simply has to satisfy a new control, which is a normal consequence of adding one and is distinct from #268's snapshot-pins.
